name: Cloudflare and Cisco Umbrella log analytics and Cloudflare ruleset review rules

case: cf-an-waf-block-burst positive: 20 blocked requests from one IP
cf-an-leaked-credential-login positive: POST login with a leaked password
cf-an-leaked-credential-login negative: POST login with a clean credential

cf-an-gateway-dns-threat-allowed positive: malware-category name not blocked
cf-an-gateway-untrusted-cert-passthrough positive: untrusted certificate passed through
cf-an-gateway-dlp-allowed positive: DLP profile matched and allowed
cf-an-gateway-dlp-allowed negative: DLP profile matched and blocked
cf-an-gateway-dns-tunnel-like positive: 20 very long labels under one parent
cfpol-no-managed-waf negative: managed execute rule present
cfpol-skip-broad positive: skip rule with expression true

cfpol-log-only-action positive: custom rule only logs
